groups.root_cause: The cached-evidence check doesn't handle a crash between saving passing gate results and marking the gate stage complete, so unchanged work gets wrongly sent for human intervention.
The amended-commit guard runs only after the initial pull-request lookup, so an earlier failure falls through to the draft fallback, which pushes the stale verified commit.
The pending-merge exception checks only the merge's parents and not its tree or content, so an amended merge with unreviewed file changes is accepted and published.
